newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates BPI Capital Finance perference shares.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates BPI Capital Finance perference shares.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Wednesday it had assigned a long-term rating of BBB plus to the issue of $150 million of floating rate non-cumulative non-voting preference shares series A of BPI Capital Finance Limited (BPICFL).
"The preference shares are guaranteed by BPI SGPS SA, the holding company of the Banco Portugues de Investimento Group (BPIG)," IBCA said in a statement.

"BPICFL is registered in the Cayman Islands and is a wholly-owned subsidiary of BPI SGPS," IBCA said. "BPIG is the fourth largest banking group in Portugal, following the recent acquisition of control of the investment and development bank, Banco de Fomento e Exterior (BFE), and its retail banking subsidiary, Banco Borges e Irmao."

IBCA said these controlling stakes added to the existing investment and retail banking activities of the Banco Portugues de Investimento group through its subsidiaries BPI and Banco Fonsecas e Burnay.
"The above issue of preference shares forms part of BPIG's funding programme to finance the acquisition of BFE," IBCA said.
